text:
ben: Noticed increasing Pending small-gpu pods in ap-southeast1c over the last 45m. Mostly CI/test shards stuck.
kai: Possible causes?
ben: Early signs point to heavy node tainting + strict rack affinity. Nodes in rack `fast-1` got marked with `gpu-thermal=true` and a bunch of tiny pods explicitly nodeAffinity to that rack.
diane: Can you share the scheduler failure reason from a stuck pod? Need the exact message.
ben: Pasting excerpt:
```
Events:
  Warning  FailedScheduling  20m  default-scheduler  0/24 nodes are available: 9 node(s) had taint {gpu-thermal: true}, 15 node(s) didn't match pod affinity/anti-affinity rules.
```
maria: The `gpu-thermal` taint is low severity, it's used to nudge traffic off hot GPUs. Ops bot should auto-clear after cooling window, but that leaves fragmentation.
kai: Right — even after taints clear, those tiny pods with strict `preferredDuringScheduling` weight set too high keep being scheduled to the same racks which creates many 1-GPU holes elsewhere. Our binpacking policy currently bins by rack first which is exacerbating this.
diane: Triage options:
- flip small CI pods to preferredAffinity (lower weight)
- enable compacting heuristic so the scheduler will try to pack single-gpu pods into leftover slots
- temporarily increase Dedicated pool headroom in ap-southeast1c
Which sequence makes sense?
ben: Short-term: change affinity to preferred for CI/test jobs and lower their weight. Mid-term: add +2 GPUs to Dedicated pool for 6hrs to clear backlog. Long-term: reevaluate rack-first binpack for tiny-pod class and consider compaction.
maria: I'll open a small PR to relax affinity on the job-x family and progressively roll (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Link when ready.
ops-bot: [system] Auto-untaint job queued for 12 nodes in ap-southeast1c. ETA 2m. Reaction: :gear:
kai: Also, let's add an alert: if pending_small_pods >= 5 && node_headroom_pct >= 30 we should fire — that indicates fragmentation not capacity shortage.
diane: I'll add the alert and create a canary scheduler toggle for the compaction heuristic. We can A/B across two AZs.
ben: Good. Monitor for eviction churn; revert affinity changes if host-level evictions increase.
maria: PR opened: https://git.company/repo/infra/PR-518  reduces affinity weight and adds rollout notes. Rolling 10% now. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: [system] Alert rule created: `apse1c_tiny_pod_fragmentation_v1` triggers to #eng-oncall.
ben: Thanks — will watch metrics for 1h and report back. If the backlog persists after affinity tweak + autoscaler bump we'll request emergency capacity from infra procurement.
